scripts.build: npm run build --workspace frontend && mvn -f backend/pom.xml package -DskipTests
scripts.dev:recovery: mvn -f backend/pom.xml -Pmapper-recovery clean compile && concurrently --kill-others --names backend,frontend "mvn -f backend/pom.xml -Pmapper-recovery spring-boot:run" "npm:frontend:start"
scripts.bruno:test: concurrently --kill-others --success command-bruno --names backend,bruno "npm:backend:start" "wait-on --timeout 60000 http-get://localhost:8080/api/tracks && cd bruno && bru run --env Local --tests-only"
scripts.test: npm run frontend:test && npm run backend:test
